description: BOPTEST-Gym adapts the IBPSA BOPTEST building-control API to the Gymnasium reinforcement-learning interface. It defines action and observation spaces, normalisation and discretisation wrappers, episode timing and access to performance indicators. Users configure a BOPTEST test case and controller; outputs are observations, rewards, episode results and building-control KPIs. Coverage is virtual building scenarios with user-selected start times, step intervals and episode lengths, not an observed building stock. Public Python source and examples are free under a revised BSD-3-Clause licence with an additional contributed-enhancements paragraph. A limitation is that remote BOPTEST use adds network overhead, while local execution requires a separate service setup. Controller results depend on the emulator and chosen reward. The interface supports repeatable control simulations using the existing BOPTEST test cases (data-boptest-building-emulator-test-cases). That catalogue parent does not explicitly include this separately released Gymnasium adapter. The README supplies a Stable-Baselines example and links the 2021 environment paper. No server experiment, emulator archive or trained policy was downloaded.
